text:
rina: Midnight micro-game: pick one song + one short story thats a perfect 20-minute unwind. Ill go: 'Nightshift' (Lucy Rose acoustic) + 'The Paper Menagerie' by Ken Liu. tender mess.
kevin: Nice. mine: 'Space Song' (Beach House) + 'A Clean, Well-Lighted Place' by Hemingway. sleepy and small. :coffee:
zoe: Ooh love both. Ill do 'Sea of Love' (Cat Power cover) + 'The Lottery' by Shirley Jackson. beautiful then yikes.
marc: quick one: 'An Ending (Ascent)' (Brian Eno) + 'The Tell-Tale Heart' by Poe. ambient paranoia.
meme-bot: Tip: reading in bed may summon plot-related dreams. :zzz: reactions: :thumbsup: x4
rina: If you like someone elses combo, drop a "+1".
kevin: +1 @rina (Nightshift + Paper Menagerie)
zoe: +1 @kevin (Space Song + Hemingway)
marc: final sign-off: keeping Eno + Poe. night yall. :crescent_moon:
rina: thanks everyone! next week: one short film + one song?
